scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir packages/interface-dms-media typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/dms-media typecheck
scripts.lint: oxlint && pnpm --dir packages/dms-media/frontend-vue lint && node packages/dms-media/scripts/check-locales.mts && node packages/dms-media/scripts/check-renderer-range.mts && node packages/dms-media/scripts/check-docs-module-version.mts && node packages/dms-media/scripts/check-docs-http-surface.mts
scripts.knip: pnpm --dir packages/interface-dms-media knip && pnpm --dir packages/dms-media knip
scripts.prepare: if [ -e .git ] && command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v lefthook >/dev/null 2>&1 && GIT_DIR=.git GIT_WORK_TREE=. git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then GIT_DIR=.git GIT_WORK_TREE=. lefthook install; fi
